video_title: NBA Champs get HONEST about Draymond Green and how the NBA really felt about him and the Warriors 👀

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Reflecting on the 2016 NBA Finals loss to the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: What was your thoughts about that series and what you think y'all could have done better?

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: Meanwhile y'all had a chance to get the Warriors. You was part of that team that had a chance to close it. What was your thoughts about that series and what you think y'all could have done better to stop that dynasty at that time?

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: Make some fucking shots. That's what it boiled down to. You can't go 0-for and expect to win. We was top 10 in offense and defense that year, so it wasn't like we was nasty. We was real good, they just went on the road and that's what happened in games. One shot in the whole series could fuck up the whole butterfly effect.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's unexpected rise as a key player
quotes.excerpt: They just got cold out of nowhere. We like, look at these little young light-skinned motherfuckers.
quotes.quote: They just got cold out of nowhere. We like, look at these little young light-skinned motherfuckers with the wild-ass black boy. Draymond Green was a hard soul though, I ain't gonna lie. When you playing against them, you don't want to admit that, but when you get a chance to be a fan of them, if it's not for him, I promise you, them shooters ain't who they is. I'm gonna throw that in his bag.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: The effectiveness of the Warriors' pick-and-roll and Draymond's passing
quotes.excerpt: I never seen the drill where you come off of that pick and roll, throw it to him.
quotes.quote: We come off the guards, we make the drills, come off the pick and roll, you throw the pass and then you come to the shot. They throw you a shot, we hit you, you get your layup. I never seen the drill where you come off of that pick and roll, throw it to him and he swinging to the help side because of the help side drill. I never seen them type of drills and to see Draymond Green master that little skill right there. That's the skill he got. He gonna roll, he gonna set a hard-ass pick and roll so hard the defense on the weak side got to pull in. Wide open shot Clay Thompson, Harrison Barnes up here. You got to pick and choose who you gonna fall off of.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's willingness to embrace his role
quotes.excerpt: He didn't go into it with no like super ego where it's like, man, these niggas got me.
quotes.quote: He accepted that though. He didn't go into it with no like super ego where it's like, man, these niggas got me out here doing this. No, he embraced that and he like turned that shit to dynasty status.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Questioning the legitimacy of the Warriors' offensive system
quotes.excerpt: Did y'all ever think that all the flare pick and rolls was fluff?
quotes.quote: Did y'all ever think that all the flare pick and rolls was fluff? The post up to Draymond Green was fluff? Did it ever dawn on the defense? I know you lock up, so what your voice was in that locker room?

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive strategy against the Warriors' ball movement
quotes.excerpt: Don't let nobody move with free motion. You can't, if you just like point switch.
quotes.quote: For us it was more so just don't let nobody move with free motion. You can't, if you just like point switch, if you don't come together, they gonna beat us. It's gonna be an ass-whooping because they was too good at that. Like you said, Dray was finding everybody in those spots. If we make him a scorer, we got a chance to slow everybody down because he can't score 100 points.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of Andre Iguodala and Shaun Livingston
quotes.excerpt: You got Andre Iguodala who will get high, you got Shaun Livingston over there who will hit gems.
quotes.quote: Then you got Andre Iguodala who will get high, you got Shaun Livingston over there who will hit gems. So those people in those pieces, man, fucking Shaun Livingston would just come in and just post there. He 6'7" playing the point, so whoever he was guarding, it was advantage and that was a two-point field goal every single time and that's like a layup. Backing you down, backing you down.
